title.narrative: Promoting Pacific Island Nature-based Solutions

description.narrative: GGGI will provide green investment TA and deliver regional green investment outputs ad part of the International Union for Conservation of Nature's (IUCN) New Zealand-funded regional program, Promoting Pacific Island Nature-based Solutions (PPINS). The program will target Fiji, Tonga, and Vanuatu and bring in regional partners, including SPC and SPREP, to deliver certain components. GGGI has been engaged to focus on Short Term Outcome 1.3 Economic case for NbS and the need for integration with Covid-19 recovery plans in the region is understood by finance ministers and Short Term Outcome 1.4 Economic instruments and other sources of funding for NbS are identified. Specially, GGGI will deliver i) a Cost benefit analyses of NbS versus business as usual in the demonstration countries for selected sectors, and ii) a regional investment strategy for NbS for the priority sectors.
